transaction.source: async function transaction(fn){const c=await pool.connect();try{await c.query('BEGIN');await c.query('SET LOCAL search_path = pg_catalog, sw_rebuild, public');await c.query("SET LOCAL lock_timeout='5s'");await c.query("SET LOCAL statement_timeout='15s'");const result=await fn(c);await c.query('COMMIT');return result;}catch(e){await c.query('ROLLBACK').catch(()=>{});throw e;}finally{c.release();}}

balance.source: async function balance(c,uid){const r=await c.query('SELECT balance FROM sw_rebuild.wallets WHERE id=$1',[uid]);if(r.rowCount!==1)fail(503,'WALLET_NOT_CONFIGURED');return r.rows[0].balance;}
